title.narrative: Regional Electricity Market Interconnectivity and Trade

description.narrative: The REMIT Program aims to increase regional electricity trade, strengthen regional transmission capacity, and enable the integration of renewable energy in Central Asia through a multi-phase approach. It involves piloting and developing electricity trade, reinforcing interconnections, and enhancing regional institutional framework.
To increase regional electricity trade, strengthen regional transmission capacity, and enable the integration of renewable energy in Central Asia.
